answer: Resist Sybil attacks by requiring each new agent to lock a refundable deposit that is only released after established peers attest its work over several epochs. Like a vine, trust spreads gradually from verified roots; a violet may bloom fast but earns nothing until checked, and no relic identity can be reused to bypass the lock. An attacker spinning up thousands of fakes must fund every deposit, so each extra identity costs real capital that cheating forfeits.
